LanguageData.MM_GizmoDesc: Choose who this colonist is a couple with, or split a couple you made.
LanguageData.MM_NoOne: No other adult colonist on the map
LanguageData.MM_Split: {0} and {1} are no longer a couple.
LanguageData.MM_OnlyMineTip: Colonists don't start romances on their own.
LanguageData.MM_KeepPairsTip: Couples made with Matchmaker don't break up on their own, whatever their opinion of each other.
LanguageData.MM_IgnoreOpinion: Low opinion doesn't keep chosen couples apart
LanguageData.MM_IgnoreOpinionTip: Chosen couples spend time together in bed as if they liked each other a lot.
LanguageData.MM_AdultsOnly: Only adults (18+) can be paired. Romance mods with their own systems (Romance On The Rim, Rational Romance, RJW) may still do their own thing.
